mandatoryFindings.category: All-consumer registered external mode/hash dispatch before body
mandatoryFindings.problem: retained_source_read tests str(path) membership before applying the System path representation. An accepted raw string /./ alias misses the canonical registry key, then generic System.read normalizes Path(path) and reads the same registered file with mode=None, without registered SHA validation or retained-buffer continuity.
mandatoryFindings.supportedInputAssessment: No type/canonical-Path-only requirement is enforced on this callback. Historical anchored_raw coerces Path(path), System.read accepts and normalizes str, and the d.sha wrapper forwards its argument directly to SAFE_READER. Usual internal Path callers do not establish a restriction excluding supported raw-string input.
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Independent Aria source/control trace bound to Quinn's single real-System/real-Custody fake alias pair a2c9db/exit0: direct bound(alias) normalizes and rejects fixed actual644 versus declared600 before body; retained_source_read(alias) returns changed synthetic bytes with wrong mode and hash, one fake body read, no registered buffer entry, closed selected descriptors and zero real boundaries. Exact alias-results SHA6abc8efaeddb52859dbdb7d74e550627bec5d864a70e01499c89a7525729338d/567B; no duplicate target case was run by Aria.
mandatoryFindings.impact: The all-consumer exact mode/hash-before-body invariant fails for an accepted spelling of a registered resource. This is a source-level reader-boundary defect; it establishes no actual private-file access/current exploit or precise immediate member of historical Source07 failure.
mandatoryFindings.minimumCorrection: Normalize to the approved System path representation BEFORE membership and use that same canonical identity in both routes, or reject noncanonical/unsupported input before access. Every accepted registered spelling must use bound with declared600/644 and SHA or HOLD before body. Keep unregistered package/binary/prior/control/qualified-baseline policies and all caps unchanged. Seal an immutable exact correction with independent affected reviews/root adoption/new source-specific owners and fresh actual scopes; do not weaken mode/hash or change original private mode.
